mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.status, GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_code ORDER BY r.role_code SEPARATOR ',') roles FROM admin_user u LEFT JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.status ORDER BY u.created_at DESC

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.status, GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_code ORDER BY r.role_code SEPARATOR ',') roles FROM admin_user u LEFT JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.id = #{id} GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.status
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_user SET status=#{status},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM admin_user WHERE username=#{username}
SELECT username FROM admin_user WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_role WHERE role_code IN (SELECT r.role_code FROM admin_role r JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_user u JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN admin_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE u.status='ACTIVE' AND r.role_code='ADMIN' AND u.id <> #{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_user_role ur JOIN admin_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id} AND r.role_code='ADMIN')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_role WHERE role_code IN <foreach collection="roles" item="role" open="(" separator="," close=">#{role})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_user_role(user_id,role_id) SELECT #{userId},id FROM admin_role WHERE role_code=#{role}
